slides.title: Displaced since 2020, still living in classrooms
slides.body: Families from Western Tigray shelter in a former high school in Abi Adi.

slides.title: Short of food, clean water and medicine
slides.body: Families at the site told Al Jazeera. Crowding is hardest on children, older people and the chronically ill.

slides.title: Clinics often lack the medicines children need
slides.body: A mother of two from Humera says families are told to buy them at private pharmacies they cannot afford.

slides.title: Shortages reach Tigray's main referral hospital
slides.body: Doctors at Ayder Hospital in Mekelle, speaking anonymously, say patients must buy prescriptions privately.

slides.title: deaths from hunger and lack of medicine in Tigray displacement camps over three years
slides.body: A Tigray regional official told AFP in March 2026. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Renewed fighting since September deepens their fear
slides.body: Return to Western Tigray remains one of the most disputed issues since the 2022 Pretoria deal, Al Jazeera notes.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let aid and medicine reach the displaced.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
